findings.explanation: Your policy includes fire damage caused by cooking or baking equipment (Section 1, page 3). You are definitely fully insured for any fire.
findings.recommendation: Ask your broker to confirm the sum insured and excess are enough to replace your ovens and premises.

findings.explanation: Your bakery relies on ovens and mixers, so a breakdown could stop production. No policy wording about equipment or machinery breakdown was found in the documents analysed, so this is a potential gap.
findings.recommendation: Ask your broker about equipment or machinery breakdown cover for your ovens and mixers.

findings.explanation: Your policy pays for stolen contents only when a thief breaks in by force (Section 3, page 7). Theft without signs of a forced break-in depends on conditions in your schedule.
findings.recommendation: Check your locks and alarms meet what your insurer requires and ask your broker about theft without forced entry.

findings.explanation: Flood damage is covered by your policy, so heavy rain at your premises should not be a concern.
findings.recommendation: Ask your broker whether a flood extension can be added to your policy and what it would cost.

findings.explanation: An extension mentions loss of gross profit if your business is interrupted, but only where your schedule says so (Section 6, page 11).
findings.recommendation: Ask your broker whether business interruption cover is shown in your schedule and for how long it pays.
